scientific_integrity: The formula is proved for all admissible orders and orientations. The mean is recognized as a classical kinematic identity and the planar mixed-area formula is standard. The finite checker is openly reproducible.
scientific_limitations: Applies to pairs of Euclidean regular convex polygons and pair-excluded areas only; no result on many-body jamming, and no independent bibliographic priority or scientific audit. Finite checker cases support but do not replace the exact proof.
title: Least-common-multiple resonance in the excluded area of rotated regular polygons
